profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer with fifteen years experience developing customer facing software applications on Microsoft development platforms. 
Able to effectively perform in leadership, team, and independent roles. Successfully collaborates within departmental teams as well as in cross-functional teams.

Specialties: C#, C++, Swift, Visual Studio, Xcode, Xamarin, WPF with MVVM, XAML, Sql Server, iOS, BLE, DirectX, Entity Framework, WCF, Azure, MSBuild, MFC, Design Patterns, Application Lifecycle Management

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior engineer developing class C (III) medical device software used to manage and configure pulse generators designed for brain and spinal implantation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior technical role for multiple projects including:
Mobile app for indexing and uploading documents to SharePoint
Prototype cloud based document imaging workflow application
Azure hosted MVC application for managing customer licenses
WPF SharePoint client used for scanning, indexing, and providing enhanced integration with Microsoft Office

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of developers primarily responsible for document processing and check processing modules for the OnBase ECM application.
Managed team workload as well as reviewing change requests and team member solutions to ensure alignment with product direction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented document import processing modules for banking products and other verticals.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Designed and Implemented tools for ATM middleware testing and demonstration.
